title: Eternal Rest (Prayer for the Dead)
text:
Eternal rest grant unto them, O Lord,
and let perpetual light shine upon them.
May the souls of the faithful departed,
through the mercy of God,
rest in peace.
Amen.

translation.latin:
Requiem aeternam dona eis, Domine,
et lux perpetua luceat eis.
Animae fidelium defunctorum,
per misericordiam Dei,
requiescant in pace.
Amen.

notes: This prayer is offered for the souls of the deceased, asking God to grant them eternal rest and the light of His presence. It is commonly prayed at funerals, during the Month of the Holy Souls (November), and whenever we remember the dead.
